Size.figmaMatrixNote: Figma Button ships 5 text sizes (Extra Small 24px, Small 32px, Medium 36px, Default 44px, Large 52px) × 6 appearances. Extra Small uses Body/10/Medium and uds/gap/4; slot icons 12/16/16/20/24 px. Icon-only sizes exist in code only.

Slot start.note: Leading icon slot (max 1 child). Toggle with Show slot start.

Slot end.note: Trailing icon slot (max 1 child). Toggle with Show slot end.

Button.figmaMatrixNote: 30 variants (6 Appearance × 5 Size). Slot wrappers: HORIZONTAL, HUG×HUG, centered, clipsContent true, bound to Show slot start/end. Slot nodes: HUG×FIXED square per size (12/16/16/20/24 px). Child order: Slot start wrapper → Button label → Slot end wrapper.

Size.note: Numeric labels match Phosphor Icon size prop (12, 16, 20, 24, 32).

Badge.figmaMatrixNote: 120 variants (2 shapes × 15 accents × 4 appearances). Shared TEXT property label on layer Label (Body/12/Medium, maps to React children). Shape=Pill | Rect maps to code shape pill | rect. Padding/gap/radius bound to uds/gap/* and uds/radius/* tokens.

State.note: Radix accordion item open/closed; Figma State=Open maps to expanded trigger.

shortcut.note: Horizontal frame of Kbd (Appearance=Default) instances — one cap per character.

Recipe.note: Default: Medallion Blue Pastel + title/description. SingleAction/TwoActions add Button footer. Search404 omits medallion and uses Input.

Medallion.note: Figma instance Size=Extra Large, Color=Blue, Tone=Pastel from Medallion set 1847:5417.

Empty.figmaMatrixNote: 448px centered column, p-24. Empty header: Medallion (64px Blue Pastel) + 24px gap + title Body/18/Medium + description Body/16/Regular tertiary. Empty content: gap-16 with Default/Outline Button or Input (Search404).

Recipe.note: Default: Outline Open menu + Profile/Billing/Delete team. Account: Outline sm Account + My account label section.

DropdownMenu.figmaMatrixNote: Open state: Button Outline trigger + 8px gap + 224px menu panel (uds/surface/primary, uds/border/primary, uds/radius/8). Reuses context-menu row atoms; destructive rows use .context-menu-item Type=Destructive.

Brand.note: Maps to Branding Appearance + default navigation tree from menu-default-navigation / uds.ai.brand-menus.

Rail.note: Expanded 280px rail with wordmark + toggle; collapsed 64px rail with brand mark and icon-only root nav.

headerBranding.linkedLayer: Brand clip → Branding wordmark / Branding mark
headerBranding.note: Instance from Branding set 1103:533. Expanded: wordmark fitted in 140×56 clip (object-contain from 200×80). Collapsed: mark in 36×36 clip.

menuToggle.note: 20×44 ghost frame with List Size=20 Bold icon inside 44×56 Toggle slot.

navigationItems.note: Per-brand demo nav. Expanded rows use .menu-nav-parent instances (Item or Branch Open=True/False); nested leaves use .menu-nav-child instances stacked below branch parents. Wireframe brand uses Icon Size=24 default House glyph.

Menu.figmaMatrixNote: 18 variants (Brand × Rail). Header 56px with 20×44 toggle, 140×56 wordmark clip, Brand extension Light per brand. Collapsed: 44×44 .menu-nav-parent in Nav item row.

Open.note: Branch only. Open=True rotates CaretDown 180° and shows Children slot in atom template.

Children.note: SLOT on Branch Open=True variants. Compose .menu-nav-child instances inside the Children frame.

.menu-nav-parent.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (Rail × Kind × State × Open). Branch Open=True: 116px with Children SLOT containing 2× .menu-nav-child demo instances.

.menu-nav-child.figmaMatrixNote: 4 variants (Rail × State). Expanded: 36px leaf row with left border indent. Collapsed: compact text row template.

.command-input.note: Inline FRAME on Command (not a component). Edit .input-group/placeholder text directly.

Size.figmaMatrixNote: Default: 64×70 slots, Display/48/Medium, gap uds/gap/8, Minus 32. Compact: 44×48, Display/36/Medium, gap uds/gap/4, Minus 20.

figmaLabels.Partial: partial entry + caret on active slot

Input OTP.figmaMatrixNote: 24 variants (Size × State × Progress). Default: six 64×70 slots, Display/48/Medium, uds/gap/8, Minus 32. Compact (mobile): 44×48, Display/36/Medium, uds/gap/4, Minus 20.

Item.figmaMatrixNote: 12 variants (Appearance List|Box × State Default|Outline|Muted × Size Default|Compact). 400×60 default, 400×52 compact. Padding uds/spacing/12 H, uds/spacing/8 V.

URLInput.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (Size Default|Small × State × Content). 412×44/36 shell, uds/spacing/4 gap, protocol addon pl uds/gap/12, control pr uds/gap/12.

Content.note: Filled shows Value layer (••••••••, uds/text/primary); Placeholder shows Placeholder layer.

PasswordInput.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (Size Compact|Default × State × Content). 600×44/36 shell, Text frame + trailing Eye .input-group-button, pl uds/gap/12, pr uds/gap/8.

Content.note: Filled shows Value layer (9:30 AM, uds/text/primary); Placeholder shows Select time. timezone TEXT follows the same fill token.

TimeStepInput.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (Size Compact|Default × State × Content). 600×44/36 shell, centered Text frame uds/spacing/4 gap; Timezone boolean toggles timezone TEXT; trailing Clock icon.

Content.note: Removable token chips — Button with Show slot end + X Icon

TokenInput.figmaMatrixNote: 8 variants (Size Default|Small × State). 600×44/36 shell, uds/gap/8, Content SLOT with sample chips, .token-input-area placeholder TEXT.

Content.note: Same 09:30 AM|PM copy in both; Placeholder uses uds/text/disabled on hours/minutes/meridiem/timezone, Filled uses uds/text/primary.

Meridiem.note: Single meridiem TEXT label driven by Meridiem variant axis.

TimeInput.figmaMatrixNote: 32 variants (Size Compact|Default × State × Content × Meridiem). 600×44/36 InputGroup shell; uds/spacing/2 segment gap; meridiem-timezone subframe uds/spacing/4; Timezone boolean toggles timezone TEXT.

Hint.note: Single TEXT property; maps to FieldDescription (Default) or FieldError (Error). Error tints label + hint destructive.

Content.note: INSTANCE_SWAP slot for Input, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Textarea, etc.

Field.figmaMatrixNote: 4 variants (Appearance Vertical|Horizontal × State Default|Error). 756px shell; Content slot 44px tall. Vertical: label + Content + description/error. Horizontal: 128px label + Field content (Content + description). Default Input demo in rebuild script only — Figma uses empty SLOT.

State.note: Dragging is a prototype/visual state for drag-hover chrome (border secondary + surface tertiary).

FileUpload.figmaMatrixNote: 9 variants (3 sizes × 3 states). Dashed border dropzone with Blue solid Medallion + UploadSimple bold icon swap. Text layers: Instruction + Helper (default/small), or Title + Separator + Desc (xs). Figma text props title/desc map to code props title/desc.

FileUploadCards.figmaMatrixNote: Figma card set 1888:5350: Appearance axis (Default/success, Uploading, Error, Disabled) with Medallion + Pill Badge (2214:5801). Uploading uses Progress instance (623:227). Actions SLOT: remove (X) on Default/Uploading; retry + X on Error. Layout tokens: uds/gap/12 padding & row gap, uds/gap/4 body gap, uds/gap/8 title row & actions, uds/radius/8 card, uds/border/width/1 stroke.

Content.note: Placeholder shows Placeholder layer (uds/text/disabled); Filled shows Value layer (uds/text/primary).

Input.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (Size × State × Content). Content=Filled swaps Placeholder for Value with primary text color.

State.note: Mirrors Input component states and tokens.

Content.note: Placeholder shows placeholder layer; Filled shows value layer (uds/text/primary).

SearchInput.figmaMatrixNote: 32 variants (Recipe × Size × State × Content). Content=Filled shows entered value with uds/text/primary. Reference 472×36/44.

Appearance.note: Default: quaternary surface + secondary text. Black: uds/color/black + inverse text. Tooltip: primary surface + primary text (Figma); code uses parent tooltip-content tint.

Links.note: On when links array is non-empty.

Link 1.note: Default first link label when Content slot is empty.

Link 2.note: Default second link label when Content slot is empty.

Content.note: Links=On only. Replaces default link nav row.

Footer.figmaMatrixNote: 1280×40 horizontal bar. uds/surface/primary fill, top border uds/border/primary + uds/border/width/1. Padding uds/gap/16 (H) / uds/gap/8 (V). Links=Off: .copyright HUG left. Links=On: .copyright FILL + Content slot (horizontal, uds/gap/16). Body/12/Regular, uds/text/tertiary.

Leading.note: Search when children omitted; Custom when children provided.

placeholder.note: Leading=Search only. Bound to nested SearchInput placeholder.

Content.note: Leading=Custom only. Breadcrumbs, page title, etc.

Actions.note: Trailing=On only. Default slot: Icon Size=20 (Question), Icon Size=20 (Bell), Avatar Initials Extra Small — direct instances, no wrapper frames.

Header.figmaMatrixNote: 1280×56 (h-14). uds/surface/primary fill, bottom border uds/border/primary. Padding uds/gap/16 (H), gap uds/gap/16. Search leading: SearchInput instance (Recipe=Shortcut, Size=Small, State=Default, max 600×36). Custom leading: Content slot. Trailing=On: Actions slot (uds/gap/4) with Icon + Avatar instances.

description.defaultValue: Design system maintainer and documentation owner.

HoverCard.figmaMatrixNote: 256px panel. Root: uds/surface/primary, uds/border/primary, uds/radius/4, uds/shadow/10. Content slot: uds/spacing/8 padding, uds/spacing/4 gap. Description uds/text/secondary.

Link.figmaMatrixNote: 4 variants. Primary: uds/text/link/primary/default → hover + underline. Secondary: uds/text/link/secondary/default → hover + underline. Inter Medium 16px.

Variant.note: 15 hues from DOT_STATUS_VARIANTS. Celery maps to emerald accent; Neutral replaces legacy Gray; Inverse uses uds/color/black (dark mode swaps in code).

Outline.note: True adds 2px stroke bound to uds/border/primary on the dot ellipse.

DotStatus.figmaMatrixNote: 30 variants (15 Variant × Outline False|True). 10×10px medium dot. Outline=True: 2px uds/border/primary stroke. Size (8/10/12px) remains code-only.

State.note: Invalid maps to unchecked RadioGroupItem with aria-invalid (destructive border). Checked uses data-checked primary fill + 8px inverse indicator.

Radio.figmaMatrixNote: 6 variants (State Unchecked|Checked|Invalid × Disabled False|True). 20px circle, uds/radius/9999. Unchecked: uds/border/primary stroke, transparent fill. Checked: uds/color/primary/700 fill/stroke + Indicator 8px uds/text/inverse. Invalid: uds/button/border/primary/destructive stroke. Disabled: 50% opacity.

Checked.note: False/True map to Radix checked state. Intermediary is Figma-only: primary track + centered inverse dash (checkbox indeterminate pattern).

Switch.figmaMatrixNote: 6 variants (Size Default|Small × Checked False|Intermediary|True). Off track: uds/border/primary. On/intermediary track: uds/color/primary/700. Intermediary uses pill SVG Indicator (20×6 / 14×4) bound to uds/icon/inverse.

IconPosition.note: Right = Content then caret; Left = caret then Content.

State.note: Open preview with overlay + content (portal state).

Alert Dialog.figmaMatrixNote: 720×520 viewport. Overlay uds/scrim/50. Default 400px + Red pastel medallion 40px; Small 320px + Amber. Header left-aligned p-16; footer uds/surface/tertiary with Outline Cancel + Default Continue.

description.note: Figma toggles description visibility; omit DialogDescription in code when not needed.

Dialog.figmaMatrixNote: 720×520 open preview per variant (overlay included). Dialog overlay uds/scrim/50; Dialog content uds/surface/primary + uds/border/secondary + uds/radius/8. Dialog main p-16 with header (title uds/text/primary, optional description uds/text/tertiary) and Content2 body slot; footer uds/surface/tertiary with Outline Cancel + Default Save changes. Top-right transparent Button close (36px, 7px offset, 16px X icon).

Direction.note: Bottom panel 720×300 with handle; Top 720×300; Left/Right side panels 384×520. Default bottom.

Drawer.figmaMatrixNote: 720×520 open preview per variant (overlay included). Drawer overlay uds/scrim/50; Drawer content uds/surface/primary + single-edge uds/border/secondary + directional uds/radius/8. Bottom variant includes Drawer handle (100×4 pill, uds/surface/tertiary). Header title uds/text/primary + description uds/text/tertiary; Content body slot; footer Outline Close button.

Ratio.note: Figma named presets; code accepts preset strings (e.g. "16:9") or any continuous width/height number.

AspectRatio.figmaMatrixNote: 5 variants at 240px reference width. Root: uds/surface/secondary fill, uds/color/neutrals/300 stroke, uds/radius/8, overflow clip. Built-in img with ratio-matched demo placeholders when src is omitted.

Tabs.note: Figma variant axis 2–6; not a code prop — pick variant matching desired tab count in mockups.

Active.note: Numeric 1–n where n = Tabs count. Maps to active tab index in list.

Tabs.figmaMatrixNote: 80 variants. Fill=false (hug) | Fill=true (full width). Pill list: uds/surface/secondary, radius-6, active uds/surface/brand-quaternary + inverse text. Line: border-primary bottom, active uds/text/brand-quaternary + 2px indicator.

Menu.note: Compose package Menu in slot `slot / menu`. Maps to AppShell.Menu / props.menu.

Listview.note: Maps to AppShell.Listview / props.listview. Includes `slot / listview-scroll`.

Footer.note: Maps to AppShell.Footer / props.footer (scrolls with main).

AppShell.figmaMatrixNote: 8 variants (Menu × Listview × Footer). Slots: slot/menu, slot/header (+ slot/header-trailing), slot/listview (+ listview-scroll), slot/main, slot/footer. DOM mirrors appshell--* regions. Header always on; maps AppShell.Header → Header trailing. 1280×800 preview.

Alert.figmaMatrixNote: HUG flex row items-start gap-12 p-16. Medallion 40px: Sky (default), Red (destructive), Yellow (warning), Green (success), all Pastel. Title Body/16/Semibold; description Body/14/Regular. Default: border secondary, title primary, description secondary. Destructive: button destructive border + copy. Warning: system/warning primary border + copy. Success: system/constructive primary border + copy.

Appearance.note: Initials = AvatarFallback on uds/color/primary/700. Any other Appearance value is a doctor portrait stem from DOCTOR_AVATAR_IDS (public/avatars/doctors/*.png).

Accessory.note: Mutually exclusive: None, Status (nested exposed DotStatus), or Camera. Status hue is not a variant axis — change nested DotStatus Variant on the instance.

DotStatus Variant.note: Exposed nested instance property on Avatar status (maps to DotStatus Variant). Not an Avatar variant axis.

Avatar.figmaMatrixNote: 276 variants (23 Appearances × 4 Sizes × 3 Accessories: None | Status | Camera). Status: 10×10 DotStatus (Variant=Green default), positioned xs +1px / sm+default −1px / lg −4px from bottom-right (matches code AvatarStatus). Camera: xs 16×16 +8px icon +6px offset / sm+default 20×20 +12px +8px / lg 24×24 +16px +4px past corner; neutrals-300 fill, 2px surface ring, regular Camera icon. Accessories use clipsContent false. Status hue via exposed DotStatus Variant, not an Avatar axis.

Branding.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (8 appearances × Symbol). SVG from public/branding/svg. CHG and Design System share unified-design-system assets. Build: scripts/figma-run-branding-batches.mjs + use_figma on branding-batches/*.js.

Medallion.figmaMatrixNote: 180 variants (5 sizes × 18 colors × 2 tones). Circle shape. Container sizes: 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 / 64px with matched Icon glyph scale.

Month.note: Applies to both Single (one month) and Range (left month; right = next month, December wraps to January next year).

Caption.note: Exposed nested TEXT property on each .calendar-month / .calendar-month-2 instance.

Calendar.figmaMatrixNote: 24 variants (Mode=Single|Range × Month=January..December). Single: 320×272, one exposed .calendar-month. Range: 672×272, exposed .calendar-month + .calendar-month-2; month instances radius 0. Selected/range fills: uds/surface/brand/primary. Default/today labels: uds/text/secondary.

Card.figmaMatrixNote: 2 variants (Size=Default|Compact). 320px wide. Fixed AspectRatio media (16:9 Default, 21:9 Compact) toggled by Image boolean; content slot (.title + .description default); footer with Button (Default/Small by size) toggled by Footer boolean. Title/Description are slot content, not TEXT props. Tokens: uds/surface/primary, uds/border/primary, uds/radius/8.

Day.note: Visible day number; empty for Blank cells. Set per grid position when building month layouts.

.calendar-day.figmaMatrixNote: 9 states × 40×40 cell. Selected + range states: uds/surface/brand/primary fill. Default/today labels: uds/text/secondary (today Body/14/Medium). Outside: uds/surface/tertiary. All states: uds/border/primary stroke. Token bindings in ai/figma-calendar.snapshot.json.

.calendar-month.figmaMatrixNote: Reusable month grid (header, weekdays, 5 week rows). Composed inside Calendar variants.

Content.note: Restricted slot (allowPreferredValuesOnly) — only .table-row instances. Maps to TableHeader/TableBody rows.

Cell.note: Legacy single-cell swap retained from the first build; the Content (rows) slot is now the primary composition path.

Table.figmaMatrixNote: Single component (no variants). GRID wrapper with a restricted Content slot of .table-row. uds/surface/primary fill, uds/border/primary @ uds/border/width/1, uds/radius/4, clipsContent. Maps to the code table-container div + table.

Content.note: Restricted slot (allowPreferredValuesOnly) — only .table-cell instances. Maps to a TableRow's cells.

.table-row.figmaMatrixNote: Single component (no variants). VERTICAL wrapper with a HORIZONTAL Content slot of .table-cell. Maps to TableRow (tr). Header rows use Appearance=Head cells; body rows use Appearance=Body.

.table-cell.figmaMatrixNote: 3 variants (Appearance=Body|Head|Footer; default Head). Bottom-border-only divider (uds/border/width/1), padding uds/spacing/0, radius uds/radius/0, text uds/text/primary Inter Regular 16. Fills: Body uds/surface/primary, Head uds/surface/tertiary, Footer uds/surface/quaternary.
